offerings.name: Reader for web search and SERP
offerings.pricing: Prototype Development: 1 Billion tokens for $50 ($0.050 / 1M tokens); Production Deployment: 11 Billion tokens for $500 ($0.045 / 1M tokens).
offerings.price_basis: 按 token 用量计费；搜索请求从 10000 tokens 起
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10M free tokens; non-commercial use only (CC-BY-NC).
offerings.output_type: 返回前五个搜索结果及其 URL 和网页内容，转换为干净、适合 LLM 的文本；JSON 模式返回五项结构化结果
offerings.note: 通过 https://s.jina.ai/?q= 调用；每次请求消耗固定数量的 tokens，最低 10000 tokens。
